scope: Final bounded publisher SQL/tool and repository/release metadata review for five unresolved high-frequency exact Wiki revisions.

source_requirement_to_close_gap: Exact publisher-bound GPML for the requested full revisions followed by the existing native reader/schema qualification. A current model, nearby snapshot, edit date or derived membership is insufficient.
limitations: The inspected catalogues are bounded; no claim that every public or private alternative was searched.
HTTP and query failures were preserved and not interpreted as empty biological evidence.
